versions.changelog:
- Major documentation update clarifying the workflow and constraints for fight video action/storyboard design and reference data ingestion.
- Clear separation: This skill outputs reliable fight choreography, action chains, spatial routes, and storyboards only – it never produces prompts for any generation model or platform.
- Comprehensive new procedures and rules for scenario extraction, action plan selection, move/skill gating, plot design, and deterministic reference routing.
- Strict multi-step file ingestion process: source analysis, user confirmation, de-duplication, routing metadata update, integrated version maintenance, and reporting.
- Reinforced priority: User-locked facts (characters, outcomes, order) always take precedence over any reference data.
- Extensive requirements for reference structure, quality, routing, and update validation—designed to maintain reliability and provenance in all fight design output.
